name_reason: fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> compliant (domain=spell/battle implied by descriptor); accurately reflects purpose (apply attack-spell damage to targets with impact+flash animations). No Ghidra address residue. Matches live Ghidra name.
purpose: Attack-spell damage applier: play per-target impact + full-screen-flash animations then apply magic damage to each target (miss indicator on 0, else damage number), and composite + animate projectile trail.
logic_summary: void cdecl. (1) fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target(caster_idx, spell_id, target_count, p_target_array). (2) fd2_animate_spell_full_screen_flash(same args). (3) for i in 0..target_count-1: target_id=p_target_array[i]; dmg=fd2_calc_magic_damage(target_id, spell_id); if dmg!=0 fd2_show_damage_number(dmg,0x5E,target_id) else fd2_show_miss_indicator(target_id). (4) fd2_composite_battle_frame(0). (5) fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths(). fd2_calc_magic_damage applies the HP decrement internally; this fn only does visual presentation. __CHK(0x24) is the compiler-injected stack probe.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_apply_attack_spell_damage(uint32 caster_idx, uint32 target_count, uint32 p_target_array, uint32 effect_param)

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Caster runtime_char index; forwarded verbatim to the impact + full-screen-flash animation functions (arg 1).
params.reason: Accurately names the caster index; matches both call sites (param_1) and the animation-call usage. No address residue.

params.name: target_count
params.semantics: Number of targets = length of the p_target_array byte array; signed loop bound (int)target_count.
params.reason: Clear and correct; matches call sites (param_3 in dispatch, param_3 n_targets in summon) and loop bound usage.

params.name: p_target_array
params.semantics: Pointer (as uint32) to a byte array of target runtime_char indices; each entry read as ((uint8*)p_target_array)[i] and passed to calc/show/animate.
params.reason: Descriptive p_ prefix + correct meaning (target-id byte array pointer). Keeps the uint address contract used at both call sites. No address residue.

params.name: effect_param
params.semantics: Spell id. Forwarded as arg 2 (spell/sprite id) to both animation functions and as the 2nd arg of fd2_calc_magic_damage(target_id, spell_id). Caller fd2_apply_use_effect_dispatch passes the item's effect_param u16 (item effect 0x15); caller fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast passes literal 0x20 (the 熾天使 summon spell id).
params.reason: The body consumes this value strictly as a spell id (animation key + 2nd arg to fd2_calc_magic_damage); the function is generic, not item-specific. 'effect_param' reflects only caller 1's local naming and is misleading for caller 2 (literal spell id 0x20). Live Ghidra and the existing plate already call it spell_id. Rename recorded only; applied in Stage 2.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was correct but terse: it stated 'effect 0x15' as the only context, did not mention the second caller (summon spell 0x20 熾天使), did not document arg 4 as a spell id, and omitted the (already-known) note that fd2_calc_magic_damage applies the HP decrement internally so this fn is presentation-only.
notes: Both callers and the disassembly confirm src is byte-faithful to the decompiler (impact+flash, per-target calc/miss/damage loop, composite+projectile). No logic concerns. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with refined understanding (same callers/body/HP-decrement note) so left unchanged; the plate's use of 'spell_id' vs src 'effect_param' is a naming matter tracked as the param rename proposal, not a plate contradiction. Working tree had unrelated modified shards from concurrent runs; staged only src/spell/spelleff.c and this shard by explicit path.
